# exodus_server (Resource)

A virtual server. It is billed by the hour while it exists; a stopped server is billed for its disk only. SSH is reachable at `public_ip:ssh_port`. Sizes and images: `GET https://exodus.host/api/v1/catalog`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exodus_server" "web" {
  name    = "web"
  region  = "ams"
  image   = "ubuntu-24.04"
  vcpu    = 2
  ram_gb  = 4
  disk_gb = 50

  ssh_key_ids  = [exodus_ssh_key.laptop.id]
  firewall_ids = [exodus_firewall.web.id]
  vpc_id       = exodus_vpc.private.id
}

output "ssh" {
  value = "ssh -p ${exodus_server.web.ssh_port} root@${exodus_server.web.public_ip}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_gb` (Number) Boot disk in GB. It can only grow, without a restart; the OS extends the partition on the next boot.
- `image` (String) Image id, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`, `debian-12`. Changing it replaces the server.
- `name` (String) Hostname: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Changing it replaces the server.
- `ram_gb` (Number) Memory in GB. Changing it stops the server for the resize and starts it again.
- `region` (String) Region id, e.g. `ams`. Changing it replaces the server.
- `vcpu` (Number) Virtual CPUs. Changing it stops the server for the resize and starts it again.

### Optional

- `firewall_ids` (Set of String) `exodus_firewall` ids applied to the server. Changed in place.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) `exodus_ssh_key` ids added to root's `authorized_keys` at creation. Changing them replaces the server.
- `vpc_id` (String) `exodus_vpc` to join (same region). Changed in place; the `eth1` address is configured on the next boot.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_ip` (String) Address on the node's internal network (`eth0`).
- `public_ip` (String) Public address of the node; SSH listens on it at `ssh_port`.
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Root password generated at creation. Not available for imported servers; changes made later in the panel are not tracked.
- `ssh_port` (Number) Port forwarded to the server's port 22: `ssh -p <ssh_port> root@<public_ip>`.
- `status` (String) `running`, `stopped`, `error`, or an operation in progress.
- `vpc_ip` (String) Address in the VPC, if the server is in one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# root_password and ssh_key_ids can't be read back for an imported server.
terraform import exodus_server.web <server id>
```
